signals.summary: An aggregator lists a $500M Series I for Rippling dated 2026-07-20, at a reported $35B valuation and $3.2B total raised. I found no primary source such as a press release or major outlet, so treat it as unconfirmed.
Rippling announced AI Spend Console, a capability that tracks and controls company AI/token spend and usage ROI. It sits alongside AI Governance and Rippling AI plugins, skills and automations.

Rippling launched the Rippling AI Lab in Bengaluru, India, a research and engineering group for continuous AI innovation. Fast Company also named Rippling to its 2026 Next Big Thing in Tech list for applied AI and data.
Rippling relaunched Automated Compliance with multi-framework support (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, with GDPR and PCI DSS due in December), an audit portal, Trust Centers and embedded AI workflows.
Rippling announced direct API integrations with Guardian, MetLife and Unum under a new Preferred Carrier Program to automate benefits enrollment.
AI security firm Runlayer, backed by Vinod Khosla, filed a lawsuit alleging Rippling violated confidentiality agreements during a nearly year-long commercial partnership. Only a snippet was visible.

answer.notes: Most sources are aggregators or Rippling's own blog, and almost none show publication dates, so I can't confirm that the product, partnership and lawsuit items fall within the last 90 days. The funding data conflicts: one aggregator says $25B valuation with $1.8B raised, another says $35B with $3.2B raised, and a third lists Series G in May 2025 as the latest round. Check the Series I round against TechCrunch, Reuters or Rippling's own announcement before citing it. Separately, a TechCrunch-derived summary says Rippling passed $1B ARR with 78% YoY growth in April 2026. That is outside the 90-day window but useful context. I found no confirmed layoffs, acquisitions or leadership changes. The leadership search returned only unrelated LinkedIn and job-board pages. Hiring looks active (Built In lists about 17 open roles, and Rippling opened the Bengaluru AI Lab), but I found no dated hiring announcement. The best hooks are the AI Spend Console and AI governance push, the compliance relaunch, and the Series I news once verified.

trace.query: Rippling acquisition OR partnership OR layoffs OR hiring
